Coram : S. ABDUL NAZEER*, DEEPAK GUPTA
Kerala Land Reforms Act, 1963 – s.72(K) and 102 – Respondent filed petition in the Forest Tribunal for settlement of dispute in relation to the land in question inter alia on the ground that the land is not a private forest as defined u/s.2(f) of the 1971 Act and it did not vest in the that the Land Tribunal issued certificate of purchase in favour of the respondent, as he was found to be the cultivating tenant in possession of the said land – Appellant-State contended that the land vested in the government u/s.3 of the 1971 Act and is under the custody of the Forest
Decision Date : 22-01-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 10075/2014 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
